entries.title: CTX mosaic, regional context (62.5 km across) centred on Oxia Planum
entries.institution: NASA/JPL/MSSS/The Murray Lab (Caltech); tiles hosted by Esri for NASA Solar System Treks
entries.license: Free use of the CTX beta01 mosaic for all purposes with credit (Murray Lab statement on the service page)
entries.acquisition_note: Mosaic of many CTX orbits (2006 onward); individual acquisition dates are not tracked in the beta01 mosaic.
entries.resolution_note: Tile pixel 81.4 m N-S (77.3 m E-W at this latitude); the underlying CTX mosaic is ~5 m/px, resampled for this zoom level.

bounds.source: WMTS/ArcGIS tile grid, zoom 9, rows 203-205, cols 440-442

entries.coverage_evidence: Bounds computed exactly from the WMTS tile grid at zoom 9; the candidate coordinate (18.275, -24.632) lies in the centre tile.
entries.relevance: Covers the whole ~59 km analysis footprint; the regional slope and relief statistics describe this area.
entries.appearance_note: Uncontrolled greyscale CTX mosaic (beta01): brightness varies between orbit strips and seams can be visible; lossy JPEG tiles.

entries.title: Clay-Rich Terrain in Oxia Planum: A Proposed ExoMars Landing Site
entries.institution: JPL / NASA Image and Video Library
entries.license: NASA imagery: free to use for any purpose with credit (NASA Media Usage Guidelines)
entries.resolution_note: Ground sampling of this web-sized asset is not stated by the source.
entries.coverage_evidence: Caption: HiRISE view of the proposed ExoMars landing site in Oxia Planum; its offset from the ellipse centre used here is not stated.
entries.relevance: Clay-rich terrain within the Oxia Planum landing region; the exact position relative to the candidate coordinate is unknown.

entries.title: Possible Future Mars Landing Site in Oxia Planum
entries.institution: JPL / NASA Image and Video Library
entries.license: NASA imagery: free to use for any purpose with credit (NASA Media Usage Guidelines)
entries.resolution_note: Ground sampling of this web-sized asset is not stated by the source.
entries.coverage_evidence: Caption: proposed future landing site in Oxia Planum, between Mawrth and Ares Vallis; offset from the candidate coordinate not stated.
entries.relevance: Another HiRISE view of the Oxia Planum candidate region.

notes: No landed mission has imaged this candidate from the ground, so no surface view exists; orbital views only.
